rows.modernEditorialQuestion: Why does the sower scatter seed on apparently unfruitful ground?
rows.canonicalSourceEvidencePhrase: the rock be made rich soil
rows.parallelEnglishTextAnchor: There is such a thing as the rock changing
rows.parallelMeaningChecked: The distinctive reason for sowing broadly is the hearer's capacity to change.
rows.contextualQualification: The Catena abbreviates the homily, and the New Advent translation is a distinct English witness. Precise homily-section locator independently corrected by re-reading the online full work on 2026-10-22.
